claim_boundary: C017 is iterative development and stochastic replication on the four supplied tunnels. It measures architecture robustness on those tunnels and does not establish prospective new-site generalisation.

data.field_evaluation_cohort: 1703 frozen tiles from the same 14 parents and four supplied tunnels

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition

evaluation.final_gate: For both all seeds and held seeds 1/2: positive 95% bootstrap lower bound, positive mean in 4/4 tunnels, positive F1 mean, nonworsening matched-sensitivity FPR, and nonnegative mean delta AUPRC for every included detector.
evaluation.held_replication_data: restorer/model seeds 1 and 2, inaccessible to route selection
evaluation.practical_target_role: predeclared substantive-effect indicator, reported separately from the efficacy gate
evaluation.primary_analysis: equal average of SegFormer-B0 and Mamba2 U-Net hybrid
evaluation.robustness_analysis: equal average of the frozen CNN panel plus the two new models
evaluation.selection_constraints: mean matched-sensitivity delta FPR <=0; every tunnel panel delta AUPRC >0; each model mean delta AUPRC >=0; active routes positive on at least 2/4 tunnels
evaluation.selection_data: restorer/model seed 0 across all four development tunnels
evaluation.selection_objective: maximum equal-model equal-tunnel new-model-panel delta AUPRC

mamba2_unet.architecture: Mamba2 U-Net hybrid: convolutional 32/48/64/96/128 encoder, two official Transformers Mamba2 blocks at 32x32, symmetric convolutional decoder
mamba2_unet.naming_boundary: This is a purpose-built Mamba2 U-Net hybrid, not VM-UNet or CrackMamba.

segformer_b0.architecture: NVIDIA SegFormer-B0 ADE20K pretrained encoder/decoder with a newly initialized one-logit crack classifier

objective: Test whether MERIT improves crack detection for a transformer and a Mamba-family detector under the same four-tunnel leave-one-tunnel-out protocol.

source_provenance.implementation_note: VMamba4CrackSeg was audited, but its CUDA selective-scan extension is unavailable in this Windows environment. The tested Mamba model uses the official Transformers Mamba2 PyTorch implementation.

training.checkpoint: fixed final epoch; no held-out checkpoint selection or early stopping
training.loss: BCEWithLogits plus soft Dice, equal weights, no pos_weight
training.precision: CUDA bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss
training.resume: epoch-specific shuffle seeds and atomic epoch checkpoints
